clues.text: Standing 53 feet tall, this coaster hits a top speed of 31 mph and keeps riders upright with zero inversions.
Manufactured by German ride builder Gerstlauer, this steel coaster opened to park guests in 2013.
To experience this coaster, you will have to travel to an amusement park located in Mexico.
This attraction is a steel spinning roller coaster operating at Six Flags Mexico.
This coaster shares its name with the iconic DC Comics supervillain widely known in the Batman comics.
